N_enrolled.long_name: Number of students enrolled and assessed for school immunization requirements
N_enrolled.short_description: Number of students enrolled and assessed in the state's annual school immunization survey (the denominator for the coverage rates).
N_enrolled.long_description: Count of students (DOE enrollment) at the school level, summed to county by grade, from the Indiana Department of Health open-data hub. This is the denominator used to enrollment-weight the antigen coverage rates up to the county.
N_enrolled.statement: In {location}, {value} school students were enrolled and assessed for immunization status.

rate_dtap.long_name: Proportion of students up to date for diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis (DTaP/Tdap) vaccination
rate_dtap.short_description: Proportion of assessed school students who are up to date for diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis (DTaP/Tdap) vaccination.
rate_dtap.long_description: Share of assessed school students reported as up to date for diphtheria-tetanus-pertussis (DTaP/Tdap) vaccination in the state's annual school immunization survey. The antigen-specific series definition, the grade(s) assessed, and whether the figure reflects all enrolled students or only those surveyed vary by state; see the source description.
rate_dtap.statement: In {location}, {value} of school students were up to date for DTaP/Tdap vaccination.

in_school_immunization.name: Indiana School Immunization Coverage
in_school_immunization.description: County-level, multi-grade antigen coverage from the Indiana Department of Health open-data hub (CKAN); per-year workbooks are enumerated via the package_show API so the series self-updates.
in_school_immunization.restrictions: Public data. The hub files carry no medical/religious exemption split, so exemption columns are unavailable (NA).
